name: Di Dong Il Corporation
summary: Established in Seoul, South Korea, in 1955, Di Dong Il Corporation is a prominent player in the South Korean textile sector. The company's product portfolio encompasses a variety of greige yarns, including pure cotton, regenerated, synthetic, and diverse blended fibers. It also specializes in dyed yarns, offering silket, continuous silket, and cheese-dyed options, in addition to manufacturing fabrics. Furthermore, Di Dong Il develops innovative textile technologies such as TransDry, engineered for superior moisture-wicking and rapid drying capabilities, and WarmFresh, which provides moisture absorption, heat generation, anti-bacterial properties, odor control, and pH regulation.
